issues.description: Documentation describes the {wslprefix} variable but doesn't provide complete details about when it's populated or example values
issues.current_content: {wslprefix}: WSL distro prefix like `wsl$/Ubuntu` (Windows only, set when running in WSL)

issues.description: Documentation explains double-brace escaping but could clarify the validation constraints
issues.current_content: To include literal braces, use double braces: {{ for { and }} for }
